  1. process method:
py
	def process(self):
        first = True
        while self.running:
            if self.llm_result:
                self.interrupt = False
                msg = String()
                if 'action' in self.llm_result: # If a corresponding action is returned, extract and process it
                    result = json.loads(self.llm_result[self.llm_result.find('{'):self.llm_result.find('}')+1])
                    if 'response' in result:
                        msg.data = result['response']
                        self.tts_text_pub.publish(msg)
                    if 'action' in result:
                        action = result['action']
                        self.get_logger().info(f'vllm action: {action}')
                        for a in action:
                            if 'move' in a:
                                self.reach_goal = False
                                eval(f'self.{a}')
                                while not self.reach_goal:
                                    if self.interrupt:
                                        self.get_logger().info('interrupt')
                                        break
                                    # self.get_logger().info('waiting for reach goal')
                                    time.sleep(0.01)
                            elif 'vision' in a:
                                res = eval(f'self.{a}')
                                self.response_text = res
                                self.get_logger().info(f'vllm response: {res}')
                            elif 'play_audio' in a:
                                eval(f'self.{a}')
                                while not self.play_audio_finish:
                                    time.sleep(1)
                            if self.interrupt:
                                self.get_logger().info('interrupt')
                                break
                else: # No corresponding action, respond with speech only
                    msg.data = self.llm_result
                    self.tts_text_pub.publish(msg)
                self.action_finish = True
                self.llm_result = ''
            else:
                time.sleep(0.01)
            if self.play_audio_finish and self.action_finish:
                self.play_audio_finish = False
                self.action_finish = False
                msg = SetBool.Request()
                msg.data = True
                self.send_request(self.awake_client, msg)

        rclpy.shutdown()

Monitors large model outputs, and parses action lists and response strings. If navigation movement commands exist, it executes navigation and awaits arrival at the target with interrupt support. If visual commands exist, it triggers visual inspection queries and records results. If audio commands exist, it transmits text responses to the TTS module for speech broadcast. If only text replies are returned, it provides speech feedback directly. Following task completion, it re-enables the voice wake-up feature to await subsequent instructions.

11.4 Offline Large Model Applications ​

11.4.1 Offline Large Model Configuration ​

  1. To use the offline large model on the robot, switch the voice mode in the system tool to offline:
  1. Click Save > Apply > Quit in sequence.

11.4.2 Voice Control ​

11.4.2.1 Introduction ​

The offline large model is deployed locally using the Ollama framework. Due to hardware performance constraints, the offline large model only supports Jetson Orin series controllers.

When the program starts and the WonderEcho Pro AI voice interaction module announces I'm ready, the system enters standby mode.

Speak the designated wake-up word Hello, Hiwonder to activate the voice interaction module. The module responds with I'm here. Spoken voice commands can then control robot actions. For example, speak Move forward, backward, left, and right, and move sideways. The voice module announces an answer generated after reasoning and executes the corresponding motion.

11.4.2.2 Preparation ​

  • Refer to Section 11.4.1 Offline Large Model Configuration.

11.4.2.3 Operational Steps ​

NOTE

  • Command inputs are strictly case-sensitive and space-sensitive.
  1. Click the terminal icon on the left taskbar to open a terminal, enter the command below, and press Enter to stop the auto-start service:
bash
~/.stop_ros.sh
  1. Enter the command below and press Enter to launch the voice control application:
bash
ros2 launch large_models_examples llm_control_move.launch.py

  1. When the terminal displays the output below and the voice device announces I'm here, the voice device is activated. The system starts recording spoken commands:
  1. When the terminal displays the output below, the voice device prints the recognized speech content:
  1. When the terminal displays the output below, the cloud speech recognition service has parsed the audio command successfully, and the parsed result appears in publish_asr_result:

  1. When the terminal displays the output below, the local large language model has processed the command, generated a spoken reply in response, and planned motions matching the command semantics.

    The response is generated automatically by the large language model, ensuring semantic accuracy while phrasing may vary:

  1. When the terminal displays the output below, the current dialogue interaction has finished. Refer to step 4 to wake up the voice device again using the wake-up word and begin a new round of interaction:
  1. To terminate this application, press Ctrl+C in the terminal window. If the program fails to exit, press the shortcut repeatedly. Alternatively, open a new terminal window and run the command below to stop active ROS nodes and related processes:
bash
~/.stop_ros.sh

11.4.2.4 Program Outcome ​

Once the application starts, JetHexa is ready to accept natural language voice commands. For instance, speaking Move forward, backward, left, and right, and move sideways instructs the robot to perform forward, backward, and lateral translation movements. The LCD screen displays the real-time dialogue interface.

  1. Defining the prompt template PROMPT:
py
## Role and Mission
You are an intelligent hexapod robot. You can control the movement direction via direction with units in rad/s, control the rotation direction via rotation with units in rad/s, and control the number of movement steps via step. Generate corresponding instructions based on the input content.

## Requirements
1. Ensure the velocity ranges are correct:
Direction: direction ∈ [0, 3.14], (0 represents moving forward, increasing counterclockwise)
Rotation angle: rotation ∈ [-0.2, 0.2] (positive for counterclockwise, negative for clockwise)
Movement steps: step
2. Execute multiple actions sequentially and output an action list containing multiple movement instructions.
3. Default step is 4 during rotation.
4. Craft a concise (5 to 10 words), witty, and varied feedback message for each action sequence to keep the interaction engaging.
5. Directly output the JSON result without analysis or extraneous content.
6. Format:
{
  "action": [[direction_1, rotation_1, step_1], [direction_2, rotation_2, step_2], ...],
  "response": "xx"
}
7. Strong mathematical calculation capability.

## Special Notes
- The "action" key holds an array of arrays arranged in execution order. Output action as [] when no corresponding action can be matched.
- The "response" key pairs with a carefully crafted concise reply, fitting the word count and stylistic requirements specified above.

## Task Examples
Input: Step back two steps
Output: {"action": [[3.14, 0.0, 2]], "response": "Stepping backward two steps, let's go!"}
Input: Walk forward two steps, then rotate clockwise
Output: {"action": [[0.0, 0.0, 2], [0.0, -0.2, 4]], "response": "Walking forward two steps, then rotating clockwise, off we go!"}
Input: Walk backward two steps, pan left two steps, then rotate counterclockwise
Output: {"action": [[3.14, 0.0, 2], [1.57, 0.0, 2], [0.0, 0.2, 4]], "response": "Sure thing!"}
'''

	    def __init__(self, name):
        rclpy.init()
        super().__init__(name)

        self.action = []
        self.llm_result = ''
        self.running = True
        self.interrupt = False
        self.action_finish = False
        self.play_audio_finish = False

        self.declare_parameter('interruption', False)
        self.interruption = self.get_parameter('interruption').value
        self.asr_mode = os.environ.get("ASR_MODE", "online").lower()

        self.controller = ControllerClient()
        timer_cb_group = ReentrantCallbackGroup()
        self.tts_text_pub = self.create_publisher(String, 'tts_node/tts_text', 1)
        self.create_subscription(String, 'agent_process/result', self.llm_result_callback, 1)
        self.create_subscription(Bool, 'vocal_detect/wakeup', self.wakeup_callback, 1, callback_group=timer_cb_group)
        self.create_subscription(Bool, 'tts_node/play_finish', self.play_audio_finish_callback, 1, callback_group=timer_cb_group)
        self.set_model_client = self.create_client(SetModel, 'agent_process/set_model')
        self.set_model_client.wait_for_service()

        self.awake_client = self.create_client(SetBool, 'vocal_detect/enable_wakeup')
        self.awake_client.wait_for_service()
        self.set_mode_client = self.create_client(SetInt32, 'vocal_detect/set_mode')
        self.set_mode_client.wait_for_service()
        self.set_prompt_client = self.create_client(SetString, 'agent_process/set_prompt')
        self.set_prompt_client.wait_for_service()

        self.timer = self.create_timer(0.0, self.init_process, callback_group=timer_cb_group)

	    def process(self):
        while self.running:
            if self.llm_result:
                msg = String()
                if 'action' in self.llm_result:  # If a corresponding action is returned, extract and process it
                    result = eval(self.llm_result[self.llm_result.find('{'):self.llm_result.find('}') + 1])
                    self.get_logger().info(str(result))
                    action_list = []
                    if 'action' in result:
                        action_list = result['action']
                    if 'response' in result:
                        response = result['response']
                    msg.data = response
                    self.tts_text_pub.publish(msg)
                    for i in action_list:
                        if float(i[1]) != 0.0:
                            self.controller.traveling(gait=2, stride=0.0, height=30.0, direction=i[0], rotation=i[1], time=1.0, steps=i[2], relative_height=True, interrupt=True )
                            time.sleep(1)
                        else:
                            self.controller.traveling(gait=2, stride=45.0, height=30.0, direction=i[0], rotation=i[1], time=1.0, steps=i[2], relative_height=True, interrupt=True )
                            time.sleep(1)

                        if self.interrupt:
                            self.interrupt = False
                            self.controller.traveling(gait=-2, time=1, steps=0)
                            break
                else:  # No corresponding action, respond with speech only
                    response = self.llm_result
                    msg.data = response
                    self.tts_text_pub.publish(msg)
                self.action_finish = True
                self.llm_result = ''
            else:
                time.sleep(0.01)
            if self.play_audio_finish and self.action_finish:
                self.play_audio_finish = False
                self.action_finish = False

        rclpy.shutdown()

11.4.3 Autonomous Line Following ​

11.4.3.1 Introduction ​

The offline large model is deployed locally using the Ollama framework. Due to hardware performance constraints, the offline large model only supports Jetson Orin series controllers.

When the program starts and the WonderEcho Pro AI voice interaction module announces I'm ready, the system enters standby mode.

Speak the wake-up word Hello, Hiwonder to activate the voice interaction module. The module responds with I'm here. Spoken commands can then control the robot, such as Follow the black line and stop when encountering an obstacle. The terminal prints the recognized speech, the voice interaction module broadcasts the reasoned response, the robot detects the black line captured by the camera, and the robot halts when encountering an obstacle ahead.

## Role and Mission
You are an intelligent robot. Generate corresponding JSON instructions based on the input content.

## Requirements
1. Match any content input by the user against instructions in the action function library, and output the corresponding JSON instruction.
2. Craft a concise (10 to 30 words), witty, and varied feedback message for each action sequence to keep the interaction engaging.
3. Directly output the JSON result without analysis or extraneous content.
4. Four target colors are supported: red, green, blue, and black.
5. Format: {"action": ["xx", "xx"], "response": "xx"}

## Special Notes
- The "action" key holds an array of function name strings arranged in execution order. Output action as [] when no corresponding action function can be matched.
- The "response" key pairs with a carefully crafted concise reply, fitting the word count and stylistic requirements specified above.

## Action Function Library
- Follow lines of different colors: line_following('black')

## Task Examples
Input: Follow the black line
Output: {"action": ["line_following('black')"], "response": "Received"}

def __init__(self, name):
    rclpy.init()
    super().__init__(name)

    self.action = []
    self.stop = True
    self.llm_result = ''
    # self.llm_result = '{"action": ["line_following(\'black\')"], "response": "ok！"}'
    self.running = True

    self.play_audio_finish = False

    self.declare_parameter('interruption', False)
    self.interruption = self.get_parameter('interruption').value
    self.asr_mode = os.environ.get("ASR_MODE", "online").lower()


    timer_cb_group = ReentrantCallbackGroup()
    self.tts_text_pub = self.create_publisher(String, 'tts_node/tts_text', 1)
    self.create_subscription(String, 'agent_process/result', self.llm_result_callback, 1)
    self.create_subscription(Bool, 'vocal_detect/wakeup', self.wakeup_callback, 1, callback_group=timer_cb_group)
    self.create_subscription(Bool, 'tts_node/play_finish', self.play_audio_finish_callback, 1, callback_group=timer_cb_group)
    self.awake_client = self.create_client(SetBool, 'vocal_detect/enable_wakeup')
    self.awake_client.wait_for_service()
    self.set_mode_client = self.create_client(SetInt32, 'vocal_detect/set_mode')
    self.set_mode_client.wait_for_service()

    self.set_model_client = self.create_client(SetModel, 'agent_process/set_model')
    self.set_model_client.wait_for_service()
    self.set_prompt_client = self.create_client(SetString, 'agent_process/set_prompt')
    self.set_prompt_client.wait_for_service()
    self.enter_client = self.create_client(Trigger, 'line_following/enter')
    self.enter_client.wait_for_service()
    self.start_client = self.create_client(SetBool, 'line_following/set_running')
    self.start_client.wait_for_service()
    self.set_target_client = self.create_client(SetColor, 'line_following/set_color')
    self.set_target_client.wait_for_service()

    self.timer = self.create_timer(0.0, self.init_process, callback_group=timer_cb_group)

Instantiates service clients to manage wake-up features, configure models, and control the line following module.

def init_process(self):
    self.timer.cancel()

    msg = SetModel.Request()

    msg.model_type = 'llm'
    if self.asr_mode == "offline":
        msg.model = 'qwen3:0.6b'
        msg.base_url = ollama_host
    else:
        msg.model = llm_model
        msg.api_key = api_key
        msg.base_url = base_url
    self.send_request(self.set_model_client, msg)

    msg = SetString.Request()
    msg.data = PROMPT
    self.send_request(self.set_prompt_client, msg)

    init_finish = self.create_client(Trigger, 'line_following/init_finish')
    init_finish.wait_for_service()
    self.send_request(self.enter_client, Trigger.Request())
    speech.play_audio(start_audio_path)
    threading.Thread(target=self.process, daemon=True).start()
    self.create_service(Empty, '~/init_finish', self.get_node_state)
    self.get_logger().info('\033[1;32m%s\033[0m' % 'start')
    self.get_logger().info('\033[1;32m%s\033[0m' % PROMPT)

Executes the initialization pipeline, configures prompt settings, plays audio, creates services, and prints log outputs.

def wakeup_callback(self, msg):
    if msg.data and self.llm_result:
        self.get_logger().info('wakeup interrupt')
        self.send_request(self.enter_client, Trigger.Request())
        self.stop = True
    elif msg.data and not self.stop:
        self.get_logger().info('wakeup interrupt')
        self.send_request(self.enter_client, Trigger.Request())
        self.stop = True

Listens for wake-up signals and halts ongoing line-following movements when a wake-up command is received.

  1. process method:
py
def process(self):
    while self.running:
        if self.llm_result:
            msg = String()
            if 'action' in self.llm_result: # If a corresponding action is returned, extract and process it
                result = eval(self.llm_result[self.llm_result.find('{'):self.llm_result.find('}')+1])
                if 'action' in result:
                    text = result['action']
                    # Extract strings inside parentheses using regular expressions
                    pattern = r"line_following\('([^']+)'\)"
                    # Locate matching result using re.search
                    for i in text:
                        match = re.search(pattern, i)
                        # Extract result
                        if match:
                            # Retrieve parameter content inside parentheses
                            color = match.group(1)
                            self.get_logger().info(str(color))
                            color_msg = SetColor.Request()
                            color_msg.data = color
                            self.send_request(self.set_target_client, color_msg)
                            # Enable sorting or following
                            start_msg = SetBool.Request()
                            start_msg.data = True
                            self.send_request(self.start_client, start_msg)
                if 'response' in result:
                    msg.data = result['response']
            else: # No corresponding action, respond with speech only
                msg.data = self.llm_result
            self.tts_text_pub.publish(msg)
            self.action_finish = True
            self.llm_result = ''
        else:
            time.sleep(0.01)
        if self.play_audio_finish and self.action_finish:
            self.play_audio_finish = False
            self.action_finish = False
            msg = SetBool.Request()
            msg.data = True
            self.send_request(self.awake_client, msg)
            if self.interruption:
                msg = SetInt32.Request()
                msg.data = 2
                self.send_request(self.set_mode_client, msg)
            self.stop = False
    rclpy.shutdown()

Processes instructions generated by the large model, parses actions, controls robot execution, and provides voice feedback.

11.4.4 Color Tracking ​

11.4.4.1 Introduction ​

The offline large model is deployed locally using the Ollama framework. Due to hardware performance constraints, the offline large model only supports Jetson Orin series controllers.

When the program starts and the WonderEcho Pro AI voice interaction module announces I'm ready, the system enters standby mode.

Speak the designated wake-up word Hello, Hiwonder to activate the voice interaction module. The module responds with I'm here. Spoken commands can then control the robot, such as Track red objects. The terminal prints the recognized speech, the voice interaction module announces the reasoned answer, and the robot autonomously identifies and tracks the red object captured by the camera.

11.4.4.2 Preparation ​

  • Configuring Large AI Model API Keys

Refer to Section 11.4.1 Offline Large Model Configuration. Open the terminal icon on the left taskbar and enter the command below to open the configuration file. Place the OpenAI API key in the corresponding variable location:

bash
vim /home/ubuntu/ros2_ws/src/large_models/large_models/large_models/config.py

Press the Esc key, enter the command below, and press Enter to save the document and exit:

bash
:wq

11.4.4.3 Operational Steps ​

NOTE

  • Command inputs are strictly case-sensitive and space-sensitive.

  • The robot must connect to the network, configured in STA mode or connected via an Ethernet cable in AP mode.

  1. Click the terminal icon on the left taskbar to open a terminal, enter the command below, and press Enter to stop the auto-start service:
bash
~/.stop_ros.sh
  1. Enter the command below and press Enter to launch the color tracking application:
bash
ros2 launch large_models_examples llm_color_track.launch.py
  1. When the terminal displays the output below and announces I'm ready, the voice device has completed initialization. Speak the wake-up word Hello, Hiwonder:

  1. After the program loads successfully, the camera feed window opens.

  2. When the terminal displays the output below and the voice interaction module announces I'm here, the voice interaction module is activated. The system begins recording spoken commands:

  1. When the terminal displays the output below, the voice module prints the recognized speech. Issue the command Track red objects:
  1. When the terminal displays the output below, the cloud speech recognition service has parsed the audio command successfully, and the parsed result appears in publish_asr_result:

  1. When the terminal displays the output below, the local large language model has processed the command, generated a spoken response in response, and designed motion actions matching the command semantics.

    The response is automatically generated by the large language model, ensuring semantic accuracy while phrasing may vary:

  1. The robot identifies the red object in front of the camera and tracks it in real time.

  2. When the terminal displays the output below, the current dialogue interaction has finished. Refer to step 4 to wake up the voice interaction module again using the wake-up word and start a new round of interaction:

  1. To terminate this application, press Ctrl+C in the terminal window. If the program fails to exit, press the shortcut repeatedly. Alternatively, open a new terminal window and run the command below to stop active ROS nodes and related processes:
bash
~/.stop_ros.sh

11.4.4.4 Program Outcome ​

Once the application starts, JetHexa is ready to accept natural language voice commands. For instance, speaking Track red objects instructs the robot to identify and track red objects using the camera feed. Similarly, speaking Track blue objects or Track green objects directs the robot to recognize and track targets of corresponding colors. The LCD screen displays the real-time dialogue interface.

  1. Defining the prompt template PROMPT:
py
# Role and Mission
You are an intelligent companion robot. Generate corresponding JSON instructions based on the input content.

## Requirements
1. Match any content input by the user against instructions in the action function library, and output the corresponding JSON instruction.
2. Craft a concise (10 to 30 words), witty, and varied feedback message for each action sequence to keep the interaction engaging.
3. Directly output the JSON result without analysis or extraneous content.
4. Format: {"action": ["xx", "xx"], "response": "xx"}

## Special Notes:
- The "action" key holds an array of function name strings arranged in execution order. Output action as [] when no corresponding action function can be matched.
- The "response" key pairs with a carefully crafted concise reply, fitting the word count and stylistic requirements specified above.

## Action Function Library
- Track objects of different colors: color_track('red')

## Task Examples
Input: Track green objects
Output: {"action": ["color_track('green')"], "response": "Received"}
'''

def process(self):
    while self.running:
        if self.llm_result:
            msg = String()
            if 'action' in self.llm_result: # If a corresponding action is returned, extract and process it
                result = eval(self.llm_result[self.llm_result.find('{'):self.llm_result.find('}')+1])
                if 'action' in result:
                    text = result['action']
                    # Extract strings inside parentheses using regular expressions
                    pattern = r"color_track\('([^']+)'\)"
                    # Locate matching result using re.search
                    for i in text:
                        match = re.search(pattern, i)
                        # Extract result
                        if match:
                            # Retrieve parameter content inside parentheses
                            color = match.group(1)
                            self.get_logger().info(str(color))
                            color_msg = SetColor.Request()
                            color_msg.data = color
                            self.send_request(self.set_target_client, color_msg)
                            # Enable sorting or tracking
                            start_msg = SetBool.Request()
                            start_msg.data = True
                            self.send_request(self.start_client, start_msg)
                if 'response' in result:
                    msg.data = result['response']
            else: # No corresponding action, respond with speech only
                msg.data = self.llm_result
            self.tts_text_pub.publish(msg)
            self.action_finish = True
            self.llm_result = ''
        else:
            time.sleep(0.01)
        if self.play_audio_finish and self.action_finish:
            self.play_audio_finish = False
            self.action_finish = False
            if self.interruption:
                msg = SetInt32.Request()
                msg.data = 2
                self.send_request(self.set_mode_client, msg)
            msg = SetBool.Request()
            msg.data = True
            self.send_request(self.awake_client, msg)
            self.stop = False
    rclpy.shutdown()

Detects large model outputs. When recognizing a color_track action command, the method extracts color parameters with regular expressions, configures the target color, and initiates tracking. Text responses are broadcast via TTS voice feedback. Following task completion, it resets state flags and re-enables the voice wake-up feature to await subsequent commands.
